title: NewsStoryRetractRequest
description: news.story-retract-request@1: the body of news.story.retract on OpenVibe.News: POST /api/v1/stories/:id/retract { note } retracts a published story with a public note (editors). The story stays at its URL with the notice, becomes noindex and leaves sitemaps and Search; final. Refusals: 422 story.retraction_note_required (under 10 characters once whitespace is collapsed), 422 flag.note_too_long (over 2000), 409 story.not_published.
